playbookOutputs: Completed NaTIS Application for Traffic Register Number (Form ANR)
Signed Company Proxy Resolution / Representative Letter & DLTC Counter Lodgement Checklist
playbookCommonFailures: Foreign national visa/work permit has fewer than 3 months validity remaining at the date of DLTC submission
Proof of address utility bill does not match the exact street address on the CIPC CoR 14.3 or lease agreement

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration (for companies) or Passport + Visa (for foreigners)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC certificate CoR14.3 or clear certified copy of foreign passport & valid work/residence permit.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID of Appointed Proxy / Representative
informationToProvide.aiHint: The person who will visit the licensing department on behalf of the entity.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Address (< 3 months old)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Municipal utility bill, telco account, or bank statement matching the physical business address.

informationToProvide.label: Application Type (Company Business TRN vs Foreign National Personal TRN), Target Licensing Department (DLTC) & Contact Details
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify whether this TRN (Form ANR) is for a Company or a Foreign Individual, which municipal Driving Licence Testing Centre (DLTC) / Registering Authority will be used, and contact email/phone.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect proxy, CIPC, and utility proof documentation
Draft Form ANR and formal board proxy resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Form ANR populated with Natis proxy letter

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver counter lodgement file to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Complete pack delivered with licensing office counter guidance
